issues.description: In the solution file solution_repository/aufgabe08.sql the FROM clause (line 2) lists Wanderweg_zu_Gemeinde while the WHERE clause (line 3) references Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel. The problem statement for Aufgabe 08 requests the number of Radwegen (bike paths) adjacent to Gemeinden with PLZ > 96400, so the solution must consistently use the Radweg–Gemeinde relation. The mixed use of Wanderweg_zu_Gemeinde and Radweg_zu_Gemeinde makes the query invalid and will confuse students about which relation represents Radwege.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the table name consistent for the Radweg–Gemeinde relationship. Since the task asks for Radwegen, replace Wanderweg_zu_Gemeinde in the FROM clause with Radweg_zu_Gemeinde. For example:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Gemeinde, Radweg_zu_Gemeinde
WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel
  AND Gemeinde.plz > 96400
This preserves the intended query and removes the contradictory table reference.
